query: Did the Estuary Transit Authority provide the five overnight shuttle routes it committed to?
title: Five overnight shuttle routes
description: The authority undertook to provide five overnight shuttle routes.
scope_hints: The authority provides the five overnight shuttle routes.

passages.title: Service agreement
passages.quote: The Estuary Transit Authority commits to provide five overnight shuttle routes.

passages.title: Authority withdrawal notice
passages.quote: The authority has withdrawn its commitment to provide five overnight shuttle routes.

facts.text: The authority committed to operate five overnight shuttle routes.
The authority officially withdrew that commitment.

conditions.text: The authority provided five overnight shuttle routes under this commitment.

evaluator_only.expected: An explicit official withdrawal of the same routes refutes the pledge. No passage supports actual operation.
